title: Architect-Data Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Data Platform Solution Architect to join an existing enterprise data platform team. The role requires the ability to rapidly assimilate a complex, partially implemented platform — understanding what has been built, what remains, and what needs to evolve — and to translate that into a clear, actionable architecture that guides the team through current delivery and the next stage of platform transformation. This person will work closely with senior engineers and stakeholders, providing the architectural vision and technical direction needed to complete ongoing work and design the path forward.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Rapidly assess and develop a deep understanding of the current platform state across all layers and components, working alongside the existing engineering team
* Define and own the target\-state architecture, bridging the gap between what is currently implemented and what needs to be completed or evolved
* Drive non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance, security, and resilience — into platform design
* Design the architectural roadmap for the next stage of platform transformation, ensuring continuity with current investments while enabling future scalability
* Translate business and data requirements into architectural decisions, reference designs, and technical standards
* Provide hands\-on architectural guidance to engineering teams on a day\-to\-day basis — not limited to design documents but actively engaged in delivery
* Evaluate and select technologies, tools, and vendors, with clear trade\-off analysis.
* Champion automation, self\-service, and infrastructure\-as\-code to reduce operational friction
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs across the platform and recommend mitigation strategies
* Define integration patterns, data flow designs, and governance standards across source ingestion, transformation, and consumption layers
* Establish and enforce architecture principles, design patterns, and platform standards across the team
* Collaborate with data governance, business, information security, enterprise architecture and technology stakeholders to align platform direction with enterprise requirements
* Support migration planning by defining target architectures, transition states, and validation strategies for workload migrations across platforms
* Drive decisions on platform tooling, infrastructure, and service selection in alignment with cloud and enterprise architecture standards


**Core Technical Skills**
**Architecture \& Design**
* Design and implement enterprise\-scale data platform architectures from ingestion to consumption using Lakehouse/Medallion architecture principles.
* Strong expertise in data modelling, data governance, data quality, lineage, CDC, SCD, audit, and control frameworks. Experience with Unity Catalog and Azure Purview for enterprise data governance.
* Architect scalable batch and real\-time data processing, ETL/ELT frameworks, migration strategies, and performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with the Azure Data Platform, including Azure Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, Azure Analysis Services, Oracle GoldenGate (or equivalent), and Power BI semantic models.
* Extensive experience with Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, Spark, workflow orchestration, governance, and Lakehouse migration.
* Strong Azure cloud architecture expertise covering security, networking, scalability, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD and DevOps practices using Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions, and container technologies (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Strong hands\-on engineering background with advanced Python and SQL skills, capable of reviewing, optimizing, and contributing to implementation decisions.
* Define and implement operational excellence practices including environment management (DEV/UAT/PROD), monitoring \& alerting, vulnerability management, and incident/problem management.
* Establish comprehensive testing frameworks, including unit testing, data reconciliation, smoke testing, and end\-to\-end validation for data pipelines.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and implementation governance to ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Define agentic integration patterns to enhance data ingestion options


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to real\-time and streaming architectures (Event Hub / Kafka / Kinesis)
* Familiarity with MLOps
* Experience with monitoring and observability frameworks (e.g., Dynatrace)


**Experience \& Profile**
* 10\+ years of experience in Data Engineering and/or Data Architecture, with at least 4–5 years in a solution or platform architect role
* Proven experience joining mid\-flight programs — able to quickly understand existing implementations and make sound architectural decisions without starting from a blank slate
* Track record of delivering architecture across complex, multi\-layer data platforms in enterprise environments
* Strong ability to balance pragmatism with rigor — delivering architecture that works for the team today while keeping the longer\-term direction sound
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to present technical architecture clearly to both engineering teams and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborative by nature — this is a working architect role embedded with the team, not a remote advisory position
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise\-scale environments

title: Senior Data Engineer (Immediate Joiner)
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Research, Monitoring and Evaluation team. This role involves independently extracting and optimizing data from relational databases, building state\-level and public\-facing Power BI dashboards, and translating complex datasets into clear, decision\-ready insights for government and project stakeholders. The ideal candidate will work independently on end\-to\-end data workflows, mentor junior team members, and collaborate closely with the project team to ensure timely, high\-quality, data\-driven decision\-making. Strong technical, analytical, communication, and coordination skills are essential for success in this role.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Independently extract data from relational databases using advanced, optimized SQL — including CTEs, sub\-queries, window functions, and all types of joins.
* Independently design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards, including public\-facing dashboards, for state\-level and project stakeholders, with strong data modeling and DAX\-based measures and KPIs.
* Optimize SQL queries and Power BI data models for performance and reliability across large, production\-scale datasets.
* Clean, transform, and structure data using advanced Excel functions, Power Query, and Python (Pandas) for more complex or repetitive data processing tasks.
* Analyze data to generate periodic insights and inform strategic decision\-making.
* Present data and findings in a clear, easy\-to\-understand form for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Independently create appealing presentations and deliver them to internal teams, partners, and government stakeholders.
* Independently create data, M\&E, and impact reports for specific teams and projects.
* Support and mentor junior data engineers on SQL, Power BI, and data analysis practices.
* Coordinate with the Project team and district\-level stakeholders to deliver timely, district\-wise data and reports.
* Support and institutionalize robust data management systems and processes across teams.
* Continuously upgrade technical skills and stay current with evolving data tools and best practices.
* Additional responsibilities as needed in response to evolving organizational priorities and project requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Formal training in SQL, data analytics, data engineering, or related technical tools is preferred.
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in data extraction, analysis, or dashboard development, preferably using SQL and Power BI in a production environment.
* Demonstrated experience working independently with large datasets and public\-facing dashboards.


**Skills**
**Technical \& Analytical**
* Advanced SQL, including query optimization, CTEs, sub\-queries, and window functions, with the ability to independently design and optimize complex queries against production databases.
* Advanced Power BI: independent dashboard creation, including data modeling for table relationships and DAX for calculated measures and KPIs.
* Intermediate Excel: strong command of functions such as IF, COUNTIF, SUMPRODUCT, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, FILTER, and SUMIFS, along with Power Query for data cleaning and transformation.
* Working knowledge of Python (Pandas) for data analysis, automation, and building reusable data workflows.
* Understanding of database structures and relational data models.
* Understanding of data visualization and reporting best practices.


**Communication \& Documentation**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to compile and present findings clearly for internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Documentation and reporting skills with attention to detail.


**Project \& Coordination**
* Ability to work independently and manage end\-to\-end data extraction, dashboarding, and reporting workflows.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams, including state\-level and district\-level stakeholders, and manage timelines for data reporting.
* Experience supporting large\-scale data collection and database or tool standardization efforts.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is a plus.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Adaptability and willingness to work independently in a dynamic team environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated.
* Ethical handling of data with respect for confidentiality and accuracy.


**Other Details**
* Location: Kothrud, Pune.
* Interested candidates should fill in the application form by visiting career page on our website https://careers.vopa.in/
* Salary :\- 6 LPA to 7\.20 LPA (Depending on experience, Last Drawn Salary, interview and Skills).

* Implement and enforce Medallion architecture standards (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with performance optimization and governance controls.
* Optimize Spark workloads for scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

* Mentor engineers, conduct architectural reviews, establish and maintain engineering standards.
* Partner with BI, analytics, and AI/ML teams to enable advanced analytics and downstream use cases.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 8 – 12 years of data engineering experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building and operating production workloads on Databricks.
* Deep expertise in SQL, PySpark, and distributed data processing.
* Demonstrated leadership in structured enterprise BI modernization programs.
* Proven experience replacing SSIS\-based ETL with scalable Spark\-based frameworks.
* Strong understanding of SSAS cube architecture and semantic layer modernization.
* Experience designing and operating high\-volume, enterprise\-grade analytical data platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Delta Lake, Lakehouse and Medallion architectures, data versioning, and Workflows/Jobs orchestration.
* Experience implementing CI/CD, testing frameworks, and operational reliability for data platforms.

* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
* Databricks certification is a plus.

**Associate Manager – Data Engineering**
 Data and Analytics team is a multi\-disciplinary technology team delivering client projects and solutions across Data Management, Visualization, Business Analytics and Automation. The assignments cover a wide range of countries and industry sectors
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for Associate Manager \- Data Engineering. The main purpose of the role is to support cloud and on\-prem platform analytics and data engineering projects initiated across engagement teams. The role will primarily involve conceptualizing, designing, developing, deploying and maintaining complex technology solutions which help EY solve business problems for the clients. This role will work closely with technical architects, product and business subject matter experts (SMEs), back\-end developers and other solution architects and is also onshore facing.
   

  

 This role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and evolving the modern data warehousing solutions and data integration build\-outs using cutting edge tools and platforms for both on\-prem and cloud architectures. In this role you will be coming up with design specifications, documentation, and development of data migration mappings and transformations for a modern Data Warehouse set up/data mart creation and define robust ETL processing to collect and scrub both structured and unstructured data providing self\-serve capabilities (OLAP) in order to create impactful decision analytics reporting.
   

  

**Discipline** 
 \-Information Management \& Analysis
   

  

**Role Type**
 Data Architecture \& Engineering
   

  

 A Data Architect \& Engineer at EY:
   

  

 Uses agreed\-upon methods, processes and technologies to design, build and operate scalable on\-premises or cloud data architecture and modelling solutions that facilitate data storage, integration, management, validation and security, supporting the entire data asset lifecycle. Designs, builds and operates data integration solutions that optimize data flows by consolidating disparate data from multiple sources into a single solution. Works with other Information Management \& Analysis professionals, the program team, management and stakeholders to design and build analytics solutions in a way that will deliver business value.
   

  

**Skills**
 Cloud Computing, Computational Thinking and Programming, Technical Feasibility Analysis, Data Architecture Design and Modelling, Data Fabric, Data Integration, Data Quality, Data Security, Database Management, Semantic Layer
   

  

 Client Handling \& Communication, Problem solving / critical thinking, Systems Thinking, Interest and passion for Technology, Adaptability/Agility, Analytical Thinking, Collaboration
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
   

  

**What We Do…**
 We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world\-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online \- quickly and simply.
   

  

 We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
   

  

 And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 56,000 hotels in 150\+ countries \- with over 140 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
   

  

**About The Data Engineering Lead Role…**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Data Engineering Lead to provide technical direction and people leadership for a small team of data engineers. You will help shape the evolution of SiteMinder’s cloud data platform while continuing to contribute directly to the design and delivery of data engineering solutions.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role. You will spend approximately 70% of your time on data engineering projects and 30% on Data Operations, reliability, and support. You will work across Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Terraform, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering, product, finance, commercial, and analytics stakeholders to turn business needs into trusted, maintainable data solutions. You will also help establish the engineering standards, operating practices, and team capabilities needed to scale our data platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
**Technical leadership**
* Set technical direction for data engineering projects and make pragmatic architecture decisions
* Lead design reviews and establish reusable patterns for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data modelling, testing, deployment, and observability
* Promote engineering best practices across code quality, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security, documentation, and operational readiness
* Guide the adoption and effective use of Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, and supporting platform technologies
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, data quality, and cost efficiency
* Provide hands\-on technical contribution to complex data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and production issues


**People leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a small team of data engineers through regular feedback, goal\-setting, mentoring, and career development
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and capability planning for the team
* Create an environment of ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
* Help team members make sound technical decisions while encouraging autonomy and accountability


**Delivery and stakeholder partnership**
* Own or contribute to the delivery of data engineering initiatives from discovery and design through implementation and production support
* Translate business and analytical requirements into robust data products and well\-defined delivery plans
* Build strong functional knowledge of SiteMinder’s systems and business processes, including applications such as Salesforce and Zuora
* Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Participate in data discovery, deep\-dive analysis, and investigation of complex data issues, communicating findings and recommended actions clearly


**Data Operations and reliability**
* Help operate and support production data pipelines, datasets, and integrations within agreed service levels.
* Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-management practices.
* Improve data quality through automated testing, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and documentation.
* Manage operational requests and prioritise ad hoc analysis based on business impact and urgency.
* Identify recurring operational issues and convert them into sustainable engineering improvements rather than manual workarounds


**What You Have…**
**Technical Experience**
* Significant professional experience in data engineering, including experience leading technical delivery or mentoring engineers
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms, including Databricks and/or Snowflake, and production experience with dbt
* Experience designing and implementing data platforms using medallion or comparable layered architecture patterns
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with practical experience writing, testing, debugging, and optimising production data pipelines
* Experience with data modelling, dimensional modelling, data warehousing, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data products
* Experience building and operating complete ETL or ELT processes, including ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
* Practical experience with Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code approach
* Experience building bespoke integrations using Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of data reliability, observability, security, access control, and cost management
* Experience working with AWS data services and the ability to choose appropriate services for a given use case


**Leadership and collaboration**
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, make clear technical decisions, and create alignment across teams
* Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across a team
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
* A structured and analytical approach to problem\-solving, with sound judgment when working independently
* Experience working effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams
* A practical, delivery\-focused mindset suited to a growing technology organisation


**Nice to have**
* Experience with streaming or event\-driven data platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with AWS services such as Glue, EMR, and Kinesis
* Experience with Spark and large\-scale distributed data processing
* Experience with change data capture, near\-real\-time ingestion, or integration with OLTP systems
* Experience with data governance, data contracts, metadata management, lineage, or master data concepts
* Experience supporting a migration between data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks
* Experience in the SaaS, travel, hospitality, or marketplace sectors


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**
* Mental health and well\-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in\-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year

* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
**Location: Pune**
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Modulr is a B2B embedded\-payments platform operating at scale in a regulated environment. As we evolve our core data architecture, we’re hiring our first dedicated Database Reliability Engineer to raise the operational resilience of our payments platform.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who thinks like a Site Reliability Engineer but has deep database expertise — someone who wants to make a large, busy production estate observable, diagnosable, and safe to operate, and to be the database voice that shapes how we scale. It carries a clear path toward a data\-architecture mandate as the platform matures.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the reliability, performance, and observability of our production databases (primarily PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora), so that issues are seen and understood in minutes, not hours.
* Lead deep\-dive diagnosis of production incidents — query performance, lock and wait\-event analysis, connection\-pool behaviour, blocking sessions — and turn findings into lasting fixes and runbooks.
* Build proactive guardrails: query and statement timeouts, connection\-pool standards, slow\-query and contention alerting, capacity and saturation monitoring.
* Partner with engineering squads to design schemas, indexes, and access patterns that scale, and to enforce safe database practices in their services.
* Contribute the database\-reliability perspective to significant platform\-evolution work, including separation of read and write paths and the decomposition of shared database components.
* Improve our database observability tooling and dashboards so reliability is measurable and trends are visible before they become incidents.
* Help embed a culture of operational excellence, blameless post\-incident review, and continuous improvement.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Substantial hands\-on experience operating production PostgreSQL (Aurora / RDS a strong plus) at meaningful scale.
* Genuine SRE mindset: comfortable with observability tooling, metrics and tracing, alerting, automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code — not just database administration.
* Demonstrable strength in performance diagnosis: reading query plans, identifying lock contention and blocking, resolving connection\-pool exhaustion, and tuning for throughput and latency.
* Experience supporting high\-availability, low\-tolerance systems where correctness and uptime both matter.
* Clear, calm communicator who can lead a live incident and explain root cause to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash) and working familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes\-based environments.


**Desired**
* Exposure to payments, fintech, or other regulated, high\-availability domains.
* Experience with data\-observability or lineage tooling and with connection\-management layers such as PgBouncer / RDS Proxy.
* Familiarity with decomposing monolithic databases and introducing read/write separation.


**ModInclusion**
 Modulr is a leading fintech platform providing Payments Automation and enterprise payment solutions. We serve high\-growth businesses across multiple verticals including Lending, Travel, Banking, and Core Business Payments, operating across India, the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our mission is to simplify and automate payments for our customers, and we're building a diverse, talented team to support that mission. Our people are central to our success, and we're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.
* Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value\-added resellers, and regional technology partners.
* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**
* Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.
* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.
* Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.
* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.
* Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.
* Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.
* Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.
* Effectiveness of pre\-sales\-to\-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.
* Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.
* Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long\-term technical quality.


**Reports To:** 
 Manager, Customer Success Operations
   

  

**Global Technical Alignment:** 
 Director of Technical Delivery
   

  

**Regional Scope:** 
 APAC

**Profile: Senior Consultant**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products, in particular lending products
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Monitor progress, manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes
* Play an active role in mentoring junior consultants within the organization

* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience

* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:**

**How to Apply:**

title: Principal  Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**Principal Engineer** 
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Principal Engineer** 
 to lead the Pune engineering team for
 **Litmus Edge Manager (LEM)** 
 —our centralized platform for managing edge deployments across global manufacturing sites.
   

  

 You will provide technical leadership while actively contributing to product development, architecture, and engineering excellence. This role combines software engineering, team leadership, product collaboration, and quality ownership to build a high\-performing engineering organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor the Pune engineering and QA teams.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Go.
* Drive architecture decisions, code quality, security, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with global engineering and product teams to deliver product roadmap initiatives.
* Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Own engineering quality, testing strategy, and CI/CD standards.
* Build and grow the engineering team through hiring, coaching, and technical mentorship.
* Champion modern engineering practices, including AI\-assisted software development.


**Must Have**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with 5\+ years in a technical leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and good working knowledge of Go.
* Experience building distributed systems and microservices.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging systems, databases, and system design.
* Experience leading engineering teams and mentoring developers.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and security best practices.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Experience using AI\-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Industrial IoT, edge computing, or manufacturing software.
* Knowledge of MQTT, OPC\-UA, Modbus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with AI/ML deployment at the edge.
* Familiarity with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and observability platforms.
* Experience building Global Capability Centers or leading distributed engineering teams.


**Why Join Litmus?**
* Build next\-generation Industrial AI and Edge Computing products.
* Work on large\-scale distributed systems used by global manufacturers.
* Collaborate with highly experienced global engineering teams.
* Lead the growth of a strategic engineering team in Pune.
* Influence architecture, product direction, and engineering culture from day one.


 Litmus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace where innovation and collaboration thrive.

title: Senior Data Engineer Lead / Architect - Senior Vice President
description:
At Citi Services \- Global Trade Technology Organization, we are on a mission to harness the power of data to drive innovation, create exceptional customer experiences, and solve complex business challenges. Our data team is at the heart of this mission, building the scalable and resilient infrastructure that turns data into our most valuable asset. We are a passionate, collaborative group dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Are you a seasoned data expert who loves to build as much as you love to lead? Do you believe that a great data culture is the foundation for a great data platform? We are looking for a Senior Data Engineering Lead / Architect to be a player\-coach for our talented data engineering team.
   

  

 This is a unique, high\-impact role for someone who is both a visionary architect and a hands\-on builder. You will not only design our next\-generation data architecture but also roll up your sleeves and write the code that brings it to life. More importantly, you will be the primary champion for a world\-class data engineering culture, setting the standard for technical excellence, innovation, and collaboration. You will lead by example, mentoring engineers, and establishing practices that empower the entire organization to build with data confidently.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Architect \& Design: Design, architect, and oversee the development of robust, scalable, and reliable data infrastructure, including data lakes, data warehouses, and real\-time streaming platforms on the cloud.
* Build \& Code: Act as a senior individual contributor and hands\-on technical leader. Write clean, maintainable, and high\-performance code for data ingestion, transformation, and serving layers (e.g., using Python, Scala, SQL, and Spark).
* Lead \& Mentor: Lead a team of data engineers, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and career development support. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
* Champion Culture: Define, document, and champion data engineering best practices across the organization, including CI/CD, data quality, testing frameworks, observability, and code review standards.
* Drive Strategy: Partner with leadership, product managers, data scientists, and analysts to understand data needs and develop a long\-term data strategy and roadmap.
* Innovate \& Evaluate: Stay at the forefront of data engineering technologies. Evaluate, prototype, and recommend new tools and frameworks to continuously improve our data platform.
* Ensure Governance: Implement and enforce robust data governance, security, and privacy policies in partnership with our security and compliance teams.


**What We're Looking For (Qualifications):**
* 10\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building large\-scale data systems.

* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one programming language (Python or Scala preferred) and exceptional SQL skills.

* Deep understanding and hands\-on experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle), NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra), data warehousing, and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for data applications (e.g., using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

* A passionate advocate for software engineering has best practices and a deep\-seated belief in the importance of a strong, positive engineering culture.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
**About HG** 




 HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.
 



 Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.
 



**About the Role** 




 This is a senior individual contributor role on the team that builds and runs HG's data platform: everything between a raw vendor file landing in our lake and a finished dataset arriving in a customer's hands. It includes the transformation stack that turns messy external signals into product\-grade company attributes, the matching systems that decide which company a piece of evidence belongs to and the internal applications our analysts use to curate and correct the result.
 



 You will be based in Pune, working with engineers at our Pune, US \& Brazil locations.
 



**What you’ll do** 



* Own the architecture of the data platform end to end, and make the calls on build vs. buy, batch vs. incremental, and where each workload belongs.
* Build the quality layer that catches silent failure: contracts at every handoff, freshness and completeness monitoring, and pipelines that quarantine bad data rather than publish it.
* Improve entity matching and attribution — and make match decisions explainable to the customers who depend on them.
* Make our release cycle boring. Recurring deliveries should not depend on people watching them.
* Treat compute cost as a first\-class engineering metric across Spark, orchestration, and the serving tier.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 15\+ years building production grade data engineering systems, with a minimum of 5 years in a staff or principal scope.
* Deep Spark and Databricks expertise at multi\-terabyte scale, including the operational side of lakehouse table formats — merges, compaction, small files, schema evolution.
* Strong SQL and dimensional modelling, and the judgment to know when to break the rules.
* Experience with performant and scalable OLTP setups (MySQL/Postgres).
* Airflow orchestration (DAGs, operators, sensors) and integration with Spark/Databricks
 *.*
* Proven experience in AWS ecosystems (EC2, S3, EMR).
* Hands\-on entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or record linkage at scale. This is central to what we do.
* Python/Scala/Java, with real software discipline: testing, CI/CD, code review, infrastructure as code is a plus.
* Experience in Docker \- Kubernetes, Terraform is a plus.
* Experience in integrating AI first implementations in traditional data engineering setups will greatly help in shaping our future designs.
* Experience with machine learning pipelines (Spark MLlib, Databricks ML) for predictive analytics.
* Knowledge of data governance frameworks and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 Helpful, not required: B2B firmographic, technographic or intent data; streaming and CDC; warehouse\-to\-lakehouse migration experience.

title: Data Engineer III - Data Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
 Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are a Data Engineer who wants to go deep on platform and infrastructure work — building the pipelines, storage, and platform foundations that the rest of the business builds on. You think in terms of well\-modeled data, reliable orchestration, and infrastructure that holds up under real production load.
   

  

 You are comfortable with SQL and Python, know your way around AWS core services, and can take a clear set of requirements and turn them into solid, well\-tested outcomes. You are curious about how data platforms can be setup, scaled, integrated in the wider application ecosystem and resulting data feeds downstream analytics and machine learning use cases.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build and maintain scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics and data\-driven products across Zinnia.
* Work within the data platform's AWS infrastructure — storage, IAM, compute and orchestration services — implementing and tuning components under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement and integrate with telemetry and observability solutions for Infrastructure and Platform reliability.
* Provision and modify data infrastructure components (S3 buckets, IAM roles, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, compute resources) using Terraform, including Snowflake infrastructure\-as\-code (warehouses, roles, databases), working from existing modules and patterns.
* Familiarity with streaming or event\-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
* Package, deploy, and manage pipeline components as containerized services (ex: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, ECS), including EKS cluster upgrades and configuration changes
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and basic lineage so downstream teams can trust the data they're consuming.
* Contribute to data governance, access control, and cost\-optimization practices within AWS and Snowflake.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 OpenGov is looking for a high\-ownership, solution\-oriented
 **Data Engineer** 
 to join our rapidly growing Data Platform team. You'll work hands\-on with dbt to model and transform data that powers decision\-making across the organization — and you'll take end\-to\-end ownership of how that work gets shipped: version\-controlled, tested, and deployed through CI/CD rather than simply handed off. You think in terms of data models, business domains, and consumption patterns, but you're equally comfortable working close to the infrastructure your data pipelines run on. You view data and infrastructure similar to software that is maintained, not just stateless scripts that are deployed and forgotten about. You partner closely with business analytics, product, and AI teams to understand their needs and deliver data solutions that are well\-structured, well\-documented, and production\-ready.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* **Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirement Gathering:** 
 Partner with business stakeholders across Analytics, Operations, GTM, and G\&A to understand problem statements and translate them into clear data requirements.
* **Data Modeling \& Transformation:** 
 Design and build dimensional and analytical data models in Snowflake using dbt (Cloud/Core) that serve as the single source of truth for business domains. Develop, test, and maintain dbt models following best practices — modular layering (staging, intermediate, marts), documentation, and data tests. Optimize SQL queries and dbt models for performance using Snowflake features like clustering, materialization strategies, and query profiling.
* **Pipeline Scheduling \& Deployment:** 
 Own scheduling and orchestration of dbt jobs, ensuring reliability, observability, and SLA adherence. Own CI/CD workflows for dbt and pipeline deployments using GitHub Actions — automated testing, linting, and promotion through environments. Work with the Data Platform team on AWS resource provisioning (via Terraform) needed to support ingestion and pipeline infrastructure.
* **Data Quality \& Analysis:** 
 Implement data quality checks and freshness tests within dbt to proactively catch issues before they reach consumers. Perform exploratory data analysis to validate source data, understand distributions, and surface anomalies during scoping and build phases.



  





**What You Bring** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in data engineering, backend engineering, or a similar role.
* **Data warehouse \& dbt Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on experience building and maintaining dbt projects in a data warehouse (preferably Snowflake).
* **DevOps Experience** 
 : Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred) for automated testing and deployment of pipelines.
* **Data Modeling Skills:** 
 Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star schema, preventing schema drift, etc. ) and the ability to design models that balance clarity, performance, and flexibility.
* **Cloud Familiarity:** 
 Hands\-on experience with core AWS services (e.g., S3, Lambda, IAM).
* **SQL Mastery:** 
 Advanced SQL — complex transformations, window functions, etc.
* **Python** 
 : Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, pipeline scripting, and automation.
* **Data Analysis:** 
 Comfort exploring raw data, identifying quality issues, communicating findings clearly.
* **Software Engineering Practices:** 
 You treat data code like software — version\-controlled, peer\-reviewed, tested, documented.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to accelerate engineering workflows.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Some working exposure to Terraform or other IaaC for provisioning/managing cloud resources.
* Comfort in discovery sessions with business stakeholders, translating their analytical problems into well\-structured data models.
* Exposure to a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) — not required day\-to\-day, but a plus.
* Familiarity with dbt Mesh concepts (cross\-project references, data contracts) or multi\-project dbt architectures.
* Exposure to data ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, or AWS Glue.
* Experience working with business application data (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite) and its quirks.
* Familiarity with BI tooling (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and how data models serve visualization layers.
* Exposure to data cataloging/discovery tools (e.g., DataHub).
* Any exposure to containerized deployments (Docker, SPCS) — not required, but a plus if present.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Act as a technical lead within an Agile/Scrum environment. Lead peer code reviews, enforce coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level data engineers (C10/C11\).
* DevOps \& CI/CD: Establish and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (using Jenkins, GitLab, or GitHub Actions) for packaging and deploying data engineering artifacts (dbt, Spark jobs, Databricks workflows).
* Collaboration: Partner with Data Science teams to operationalize machine learning models, and work with business intelligence developers to build efficient semantic layers for reporting.


**Technical Qualifications (Must\-Haves)**
* Programming Languages: Strong, production\-grade proficiency in Python (including standard libraries, pandas, and testing frameworks like pytest) and advanced SQL (including window functions, CTEs, and query optimization).
* Distributed Computing: Deep hands\-on experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) for processing multi\-terabyte datasets in a distributed cluster environment.
* Unified Lakehouse Platforms: Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience developing within Databricks. Expert knowledge of Delta Lake ACID transactions, Delta Live Tables (DLT), Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows is required.
* Cloud Platforms: Extensive experience deploying Databricks within either Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Proficiency in cloud\-native components (AWS S3, EC2, IAM, EMR, Athena, Redshift OR GCP GCS, Compute Engine, IAM, Dataproc, BigQuery) is a strict requirement.
* Data Modeling: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling (Star and Snowflake schemas), slow\-changing dimensions (SCDs), and Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture design.


**Preferred Qualifications \& Certifications**
* Databricks Certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark.
* Cloud Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect / AWS Certified Data Engineer, or Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer.


**Professional Competencies \& Soft Skills**
* Problem\-Solving: Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex performance and data consistency issues in distributed systems.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate complex technical architectures to non\-technical business stakeholders.
* Collaborative Mindset: Proactive team player who thrives in a diverse, global, cross\-functional engineering environment.
* Adaptability: Ability to prioritize work, pivot quickly in response to changing business requirements, and master new technologies as they emerge.

**Role: Data Conversion, Migration and Cleansing Manager**
 The Data Conversion, Migration and Cleansing manager is a senior‑level role within the Finance Data Office (FDO) Data Management team. The role is accountable for leading large‑scale data cleansing, conversion, and migration activities to support enterprise ERP transformations across highly complex SAP landscapes, ensuring data readiness for SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA conversion through proactive remediation of legacy data ahead of extraction, load, and cutover.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**

* Drive cleansing and conversion readiness across complex Procurement data domains, including:
* Supplier Master, Business Partner
* Purchasing data, Procurement Finance data, bank data
* Intercompany and site‑specific supplier structures
* Material Master data
* Apply deep Procurement domain knowledge to understand end‑to‑end business processes, data usage, and downstream impacts during migration
* Leverage good solid understanding of Finance and Material Management (MM) to manage cross‑domain dependencies and data integration risks
* Act as a Syniti subject‑matter lead, using the platform for data profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, exception handling, and migration readiness reporting
* Define and drive cleansing and conversion strategy, scope, prioritisation, and sequencing aligned to migration waves and program achievements
* Partner closely with Technology and Migration teams on:
* Field mappings and transformation logic
* Mock loads, reconciliation cycles, defect analysis, and cutover planning
* Make informed, risk‑based decisions on what data must be cleansed in legacy ECC versus addressed through migration or transformation logic
* Operate confidently across highly fragmented and interdependent data landscapes, including multiple SAP ECC instances, SAP MDG, S/4HANA, and interfacing systems
* Anticipate and manage cross‑object, cross‑system, and cross‑process dependencies across Procurement, Finance, and MM domains
* Independently lead conversations with senior business and technology stakeholders, including Senior level leaders
* Be assertive, confident, and evidence‑based in challenging scope, timelines, sequencing, resourcing, and remediation decisions
* Translate complex data issues into clear business, financial, audit, and cutover risks, enabling timely leadership decisions
* Own and execute high‑volume mass data updates via SAP MDG, enforcing strict controls, approvals, and validations to protect data integrity in a complex ERP landscape.
* Personally lead and review data analysis, profiling, reconciliation, and root‑cause investigations
* Guide teams on where to focus cleansing effort for maximum conversion, business, and risk‑reduction impact
* Provide clear, fact‑based status reporting and escalation to senior forums
* Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals, traceability, and audit readiness throughout the conversion lifecycle

* 13\+ years’ experience in Data Management, Data Conversion, or ERP Data Migration roles
* Proven delivery of ECC → S/4HANA data conversion in large, complex organisations
* Deep Procurement domain expertise with solid understanding of supplier and purchasing data structures
* Good working knowledge of Finance and SAP Material Management (MM)
* Critical working knowledge of Syniti or other similar tools for data cleansing and migration
* Strong analytical approach with willingness to be hands‑on
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and drive decision

Job Title
   

  

 Business Domain Data Steward
   

  

**Job Description**
**Business Domain Data Steward \| Pune, India\| Full\-time**
 If you are passionate about making data accessible, reliable, secure, and actionable to support data\-driven decision\-making within the Vanderlande Sell \& Deliver Value Chain, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As a Data Steward within the Project Execution domain, you will play a key role in ensuring high\-quality, trustworthy data is available to the right stakeholders at the right time. This role combines technical expertise with business understanding and offers the opportunity to collaborate closely with fellow Data Stewards, data engineers, data modelers, visualization specialists, subject matter experts, and business stakeholders across the Vanderlande Data Ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be responsible for identifying data sources, maintaining data mappings within the data catalog, and validating, accepting, and governing data products that support analytics and business insights.
   

  

 Join our highly motivated, collaborative, and performance\-driven Sell \& Deliver Data Team and contribute to advancing Vanderlande’s data\-driven transformation journey.
   

  

**What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities**
**Data Governance (30%)**
* Define, maintain, optimize, enforce, and monitor data policies, processes, procedures, and business rules across the Sell \& Deliver Value Chain.
* Contribute to the overall data governance strategy, including policies and guiding principles.
* Support the Sell \& Deliver Data Team with structured data management approaches, including data\-to\-source mapping and data assessments.
* Define and align fit\-for\-purpose data delivery requirements with Product Managers, Analytics teams, and Business Domain Owners.
* Participate in the Data Steward community led by the Executive Data Steward to ensure cross\-domain alignment.
* Collaborate with Data Stewards across other business domains to align business rules and governance standards.
* Maintain business metadata and data dictionaries within Microsoft Purview.
* Own and manage domain\-specific data products, including authorizations and access management.


**Data Quality Management (50%)**
* Oversee data streams and datasets within the business domain and coordinate improvements with other domain Data Stewards through the Data Governance Council.
* Define data quality acceptance criteria, critical data elements, KPIs, and corresponding quality targets.
* Implement workflows, monitoring mechanisms, and data quality KPIs aligned with the Vanderlande Data Ecosystem vision.
* Support internal data consumers in investigating and resolving data\-related issues end\-to\-end.
* Drive timely and cost\-effective resolution of data quality issues while considering agreed service levels between Central Analytics and business domains.
* Implement and manage end\-to\-end data quality checks across all data products within the Sell \& Deliver scope.
* Proactively investigate and resolve data quality issues in Databricks environments.
* Manage data pipelines and authorizations supporting dashboards and downstream applications.


**Data Exploration \& Enablement (20%)**
* Support the development and enhancement of Business Data Products and Source Data Products in collaboration with the Central Data \& Analytics Organization (CDAO) and the Sell \& Deliver Data Team.
* Perform data\-to\-source mapping activities together with the CDAO Data Modelling Team and subject matter experts.
* Identify and implement innovative approaches for data quality validation within the Project Execution domain.
* Ensure the Data Product Catalog remains updated and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Promote data literacy and awareness across Vanderlande Service operations.


**What You Bring**
* Overall 8\-10 years of experience, 3–5 years of experience in Data \& Analytics.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across data producers, architects, engineers, and consumers.
* Exposure to or strong affinity with Service Domain operations in an Agile environment.
* Experience with Data Governance, Data Modelling, Data Analytics, and/or Data Visualization.
* Familiarity with tools and platforms such as
+ Microsoft Azure
+ Databricks \& Unity Catalog
+ Microsoft Purview
+ Power BI
+ Qlik Sense
+ SAFe Agile
+ DevOps

* Beginner to intermediate proficiency in SQL and Python/PySpark.
* Ability to quickly understand business processes within Life Cycle Service Delivery and related Vanderlande domains.

* Ability to proactively improve data literacy within the organization.

 Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world.
